rate_multiplier.note: Pooled within-family variance, no product weighting or trimming. Family Ea/B are equal-weight mixtures over configured destructive thermal classes. Package mean rates use engine physics from day-13 package start to day 880; unknown repackaging uses the original-container rule. Nonpositive loss uses the median positive-truncated Gaussian assay likelihood; zero-noise nonpositive loss is an error. Normal sd matches the central Student-t predictive interval at decision coverage before independent spec 9.3 conversion variance is added in quadrature. Conversion uncertainty is averaged within family, not divided by n, since calibration conditions and chemistry priors are shared. Suspension is an alias, not a fourth fitted family. Config versions: engine-settings=0.3.0; environment-profiles=0.1.0; formulary=0.1.0; lfer-constants=0.2.0; lots=0.1.0; packages=0.1.0; radiation-chemistry=0.1.0; reaction-classes=0.5.0; sources=0.1.0; stability-models=0.2.0; storage-zones=0.5.0. Vector SHA256=d2ff7ddbb26683364fa2366cc9b11ae986c5426063d11e60d7edee011ad0026c. Flight input SHA256=cbff8eaa1e4d397921ac5f36863a1ba3351980aca1a4170ab91a471ffc5b5373. Flight residual = ln(k_flight/k_ground) minus ln(physics_flight/physics_ground). Location is the mean ln residual (the multiplier's median); spread is the sample sd with Student-t predictive multiplier sqrt(1+1/N), df=N-1, the exact predictive pivot for a normal sample. No held-out row enters either fit.
